title: Meat Shop Franchise Opportunity
name: FreshToHome, 15 Franchisees, Est'd in 2015, Bengaluru HQ
description: FreshToHome is one of India's leading fish and meat brands, with a strong presence across more than 140 cities supported by a robust supply chain. - The brand offers one of the largest selections of fish, seafood, meat, poultry, eggs, and ready-to-heat-and-eat products in India. - FreshToHome is known for providing preservative-free, high-quality products sourced directly from farmers and fishermen. - The network currently comprises 15 outlets across Bangalore, including 5 company-owned and company-operated stores and 10 franchise-operated stores. - Our stores function as both physical retail outlets and micro-warehouses for fulfilling online e-commerce orders. E-commerce is the primary sales channel. - Franchisees fully own and operate their stores under the FreshToHome brand while leveraging the company's established systems and operating model. - Comprehensive support is provided in business planning, store selection, customer acquisition, marketing, staff training, and operational processes. - Preferred franchise locations in Bangalore include the Airport Road stretch, Sarjapura Road stretch, Whitefield, and Budigere Cross. - If a franchisee is unable to identify or set up a suitable outlet, an existing company-owned store can be converted into a franchise outlet for the franchisee to operate. - The business holds all required registrations, including FSSAI, the local State Trade License, MCA registration, and GST registration.
